title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: Hold: the briefing treats documented governance coverage as unresolved. Microsoft documents AI provider access enforcement for experiences managed through Power Platform admin center, and AI Hub explicitly directs administrators to capacity management to control Journey Creation Agent usage. The roadmap facts, enablement paths and automation calls are supported.
